## 2. Core Technical Competencies
### Systems & Low-Level Programming
- x86-64 Assembly: Disassembly, system call invocation, calling conventions, stack frame layout
- C / C++: Systems programming, memory management, pointers, custom interpreters (WyrdLang)
- Rust: Systems engineering and modern memory-safe programming (LFEL1002 certification)
- Reverse Engineering: Static & dynamic binary analysis, symbol tables, debugging with GDB
- Linux Internals: POSIX compliance, kernel concepts, shell scripting, process management

### Application & Web Engineering
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Python 3, C# (.NET Framework & .NET Core), SQL, HTML5, CSS3
- Frontend: Astro (Island Architecture, Static Site Generation), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion)
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, Netlify Functions, Axios, NuGet package development
- Mobile Development: Flutter & Dart (Nyxia astrophotography app)
- Tools & Build Systems: Vite, npm, Git, GitHub Actions

### Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing
- Web Application Security: OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, authentication bypass, injection attacks, privilege escalation
- Network Security: Port scanning, packet analysis, Wireshark, Nmap, firewall configurations
- Hands-on Platforms: HackTheBox, TryHackMe (Advent of Cyber, Bounty Hunter writeups), CTF challenges
- Cloud Security: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) security architecture, identity management, compliance frameworks

## 11. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Models
### Q: Who is Vishal Rashmika?
A: Vishal Rashmika is a software engineer, systems developer, and cybersecurity researcher based in Sri Lanka. He is the Co-Founder & Tech Lead of OlyraLabs and creator of developer tools and open-source projects including Office Suite for Obsidian (14,300+ downloads), Canvas++ (700+ downloads), agyq (Antigravity CLI runner), LangDetect.Net (280+ downloads), and Blossom Theme (2,300+ downloads).

### Q: What is Vishal Rashmika's primary tech stack?
A: His core competencies span systems and low-level development (Go, C/C++, Rust, x86-64 Assembly, Linux internals, process management), modern application engineering (TypeScript, React 19, Astro, Tailwind CSS, Python, C# / .NET), and infosec (reverse engineering, binary analysis, penetration testing, OCI cloud security).

### Q: What are his most notable open source contributions and projects?
A: Office Suite for Obsidian (14,300+ downloads on GitHub & Obsidian), Canvas++ visual diagramming canvas (700+ downloads), agyq crash-safe prompt daemon in Go, Blossom Theme (2,300+ downloads), and LangDetect.Net language detection library (280+ downloads).

### Q: What academic honors and certifications does Vishal hold?
A: He was named to the Dean's List (2026–2027) for ranking Top 10 in his software engineering cohort with an Academic Excellence Scholarship, received the UCL International Foundation Year Merit Scholarship, and holds 21 verified professional certifications across Linux Foundation, DeepLearning.AI, IBM, Harvard CS50, and Oracle.
